datasheet_identity.title: 1N4001W THRU 1N4007W Surface Mount General Purpose Rectifier

extraction_notes: Forward and reverse typical-characteristics traces were digitized from p. 2 Fig. 3 and Fig. 4; points are sampled from the plotted traces rather than interpolated tabular values.
Fig. 3 conditions are Tj = 25 degC, 300 us pulse width, and 1% duty cycle; its y-axis is logarithmic instantaneous forward current.

Fig. 4 contains separate Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 125 degC reverse-current traces. Its x-axis is percent of rated peak reverse voltage; plotted percentages were converted to volts using 1N4002W VRRM = 100 V, and reverse-current magnitude is represented as positive current.
The 2.0 uA reverse-current limit at TA = 25 degC and VR = VDC is used; the separate 200 uA high-temperature IR2 row is not used.
Reverse recovery is not modelled: the datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery time.
Reverse breakdown is not fitted: the datasheet gives no tabulated breakdown-voltage/current specification.
Package parasitics and self-heating are not modelled; temperature-dependent behavior is represented only by the plotted typical reverse curves.
